findings: AInfer Level Zero recorded decode achieves 34.34 tok/s, outperforming 8-thread CPU baseline (9.98 tok/s) by 3.44x.
AInfer Level Zero recorded decode achieves 34.34 tok/s, surpassing llama.cpp Vulkan (29.33 tok/s) by 1.17x (117.1% relative throughput) via batched MoE dispatch and fused LM-head argmax.
AInfer prefill throughput reached 78.92 tok/s directly into decode-layout KV and SSM states.
AInfer provides 100% deterministic memory allocation (18.03 GiB static arena, 0 KB runtime heap growth) and zero CPU dispatch overhead via Level Zero recorded command lists.
